tool-fontextractor.title: Font Extractor
tool-fontextractor.description: Inspect bounded font declarations from a public website without downloading font files.

ui.heading: Website Font Extractor
ui.similarHint: Heuristic alternatives. Links open Google Fonts only after you select them.
ui.blocked: Website analysis is blocked until you allow the disclosed external service.
ui.noneDetailed: No web font declarations were found. The site may use system fonts or dynamic loading.
ui.consentDisclosure: Analysis sends the target URL to this site's server, which fetches bounded public HTML and CSS. Font files are not fetched.
ui.truncated: Results may be incomplete because the scan reached its safe {{reasons}} limit.
ui.none: No web font declarations were found.
ui.disclaimer: This scan reports declarations found in bounded public HTML and CSS; it does not prove a font was rendered. Dynamically loaded or authenticated styles may not be detected. Recommendations are local heuristics.
